entities.title: Software system browser
entities.summary: A static page that shows a repository's .dev folders: its diagrams drawn, its behavior views and knowledge files written out.
entities.purpose: Lets a person read what agents keep in a repository's .dev folders (how it is built, what it does and what it knows about itself) in a browser, with nothing to install, clone or run.
boundaries: It reads .dev files; it never writes to a repository.
It runs entirely in the reader's browser: no server, no build step, one HTML file.
What it reads is defined by the skills in Agents/Skills and the catalogue in Agents/Knowledge; when they change, the page follows them.
The copy people use is published on icelander.net; this folder is its source.
entities.details: The folder holds `index.html`, the whole page, and `README.md`, which says how to use it and how it works. Its `.dev/` folder describes the browser itself, as fully as a designer needs to make a pass at it: start with the [design pass](software-system-browser/.dev/backlog.json) item, which says what to read in what order.

relationships.description: The views it draws and writes out.
